packs.title: Core Java
packs.covers: The JDK itself, whatever framework sits on top: injection into commands, code, reflection, LDAP and XPath; XML parsers; outbound URLs; archives; file paths; Java and polymorphic deserialization; JWT libraries.

packs.title: Cryptography and TLS
packs.covers: JCA ciphers, digests, random numbers, keys and IVs; TLS contexts, trust managers and hostname verifiers; credentials written into the source.

packs.title: Spring
packs.covers: Spring Framework, Boot, Security, Data and Cloud: security filter chains, controllers, SpEL, actuator, and application.properties / application.yml.

packs.title: Jakarta EE and other frameworks
packs.covers: Everything that is not Spring: Servlet, JAX-RS, JSF and web.xml; Struts; Quarkus, Micronaut, Helidon, Vert.x and Dropwizard, and their configuration.

packs.title: Persistence
packs.covers: JDBC, JPA and Hibernate, JdbcTemplate, MyBatis, jOOQ, MongoDB and other NoSQL drivers, and the JDBC URLs and schema settings that configure them.

packs.title: Templates and views
packs.covers: Thymeleaf, JSP and JSTL, JSF Facelets, FreeMarker, Velocity, Pebble, Mustache and Handlebars: output escaping and templates built at run time.

packs.title: Logging
packs.covers: Log4j 2, Logback, SLF4J and java.util.logging: lookups, secrets written to logs, and stack traces sent to the caller.

packs.title: Build and dependencies
packs.covers: Maven pom.xml and Gradle build scripts: repositories, checksums, and dependency versions with known remote-code-execution flaws.

packs.title: Android
packs.covers: Android apps in Java or Kotlin: WebView, TLS error handling, file modes, components and the AndroidManifest.xml flags that expose them.

rules.title: Unsafe polymorphic deserialization
rules.refuses: Jackson default typing; an XStream built with no allowlist
rules.silent_on: a plain `ObjectMapper`; an XStream that allowlists
rules.constraint: never(enable): jackson activateDefaultTyping|enableDefaultTyping; never(build): XStream without allowTypes|allowTypeHierarchy

cwe.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

rules.title: Java deserialization of request data
rules.refuses: `ObjectInputStream` over request data
rules.silent_on: a stream the application opened itself; the same bytes read as JSON
rules.constraint: never(construct): ObjectInputStream over @RequestBody|request.getInputStream -- the bytes name the classes; carry the payload as JSON into a declared type

cwe.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

rules.title: JWT read without verifying its signature
rules.refuses: `parseClaimsJwt`, `parseUnsecuredClaims`, `Algorithm.none()`, `SignatureAlgorithm.NONE`; `JWT.decode` where nothing in the file verifies
rules.silent_on: `parseClaimsJws`, `parseSignedClaims`, a real algorithm, issuing a token, and a decode beside a verify
rules.constraint: never(call): parseClaimsJwt|parseUnsecuredClaims|Algorithm.none|SignatureAlgorithm.NONE, or JWT.decode where nothing in the file verifies -- they skip the signature; use parseClaimsJws|parseSignedClaims with a key

cwe.name: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

rules.title: Path built from request data
rules.refuses: a file path a method body shows request data reaching
rules.silent_on: a constant path; a name taken with `getFileName`; a parsed number
rules.constraint: never(open): a file path built from @RequestParam|@PathVariable|request.get* -- take getFileName, resolve against a fixed base, check startsWith

cwe.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
External Control of File Name or Path

rules.title: Command built from request data
rules.refuses: a process launch or `.command()` a method body shows request data reaching
rules.silent_on: a constant command; an argument array built entirely of constants; a value validated against an allowlist before the launch
rules.constraint: never(run): Runtime.getRuntime().exec|new ProcessBuilder|.command( over @RequestParam|@PathVariable|request.get* -- pass a fixed executable and each argument as its own array element, never a shell string

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')

rules.title: Expression engine evaluating request data
rules.refuses: a `ScriptEngine.eval`, `GroovyShell.evaluate`, `Ognl.getValue`/`parseExpression`, `MVEL.eval`/`compileExpression`, or `ExpressionFactory.createValueExpression`/`createMethodExpression` a method body shows request data reaching, in a file that imports the engine
rules.silent_on: the same call over a constant expression; the engine's import with no request data reaching it; the same file with no scripting or EL import at all
rules.constraint: never(evaluate): ScriptEngine|GroovyShell|Ognl|MVEL|ExpressionFactory over @RequestParam|@PathVariable|request.get* -- evaluate a fixed expression, or look the value up by a validated name instead of evaluating it

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

rules.title: Reflection driven by request data
rules.refuses: a `Class.forName`, `.loadClass`, or `.getMethod` a method body shows request data reaching
rules.silent_on: a constant class or method name; a name checked against an allowlist before the call; reflection over a name the application computed itself
rules.constraint: never(load): Class.forName|.loadClass|.getMethod over @RequestParam|@PathVariable|request.get* -- look the name up in a fixed allowlist rather than handing it to reflection

cwe.name: Use of Externally-Controlled Input to Select Classes or Code ('Unsafe Reflection')

rules.title: XML parser vulnerable to external entities
rules.refuses: a `DocumentBuilderFactory`/`SAXParserFactory`/`XMLInputFactory`/`TransformerFactory`/`SchemaFactory`/`XMLReaderFactory`/dom4j `SAXReader`/jdom2 `SAXBuilder` this file builds with no hardening call anywhere in it
rules.silent_on: the same factory beside `disallow-doctype-decl`, `external-general-entities`, `XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD`/`ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA`, `FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING`, or `XMLInputFactory.SUPPORT_DTD`/`IS_SUPPORTING_EXTERNAL_ENTITIES` set false anywhere in the same file
rules.constraint: never(build): DocumentBuilderFactory|SAXParserFactory|XMLInputFactory|TransformerFactory|SchemaFactory|XMLReaderFactory|SAXReader|SAXBuilder with no disallow-doctype-decl|external-general-entities|ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD|SUPPORT_DTD hardening anywhere in the file -- a document's DOCTYPE can then reach local files or make requests on the parser's behalf

cwe.name: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

rules.title: Arbitrary-execution deserializer (XMLDecoder / unsafe SnakeYAML)
rules.refuses: `new XMLDecoder(` over any input; `new Yaml(new Constructor(Object.class))` or `new UnsafeConstructor` in a file that imports SnakeYAML and calls `.load`
rules.silent_on: `new Yaml()` with no argument; `new Yaml(new Constructor(SomeType.class))`; `new Yaml(new SafeConstructor())`; a file that never calls `.load`
rules.constraint: never(construct): new XMLDecoder(; never(build): new Yaml(new Constructor(Object.class...)) | new UnsafeConstructor in a file that imports org.yaml.snakeyaml and calls .load -- neither reads its input as data; construct Yaml with no argument, or a Constructor scoped to one class

cwe.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

rules.title: Outbound URL built from request data
rules.refuses: a `new URL`, `URI.create`/`new URI`, `HttpRequest.newBuilder`/`.uri`, RestTemplate/WebClient call, `HttpGet`/`HttpPost`, OkHttp `.url`, or `Jsoup.connect` a method body shows request data reaching
rules.silent_on: a constant or configured URL; a literal that fixes scheme and host (`"https://api.x/v1?q=" + q`) or is a path on this server (`"/users/" + id`); a host checked against an allowlist before the call; the same builder called with no request data reaching it
rules.constraint: never(call): new URL|URI.create|new URI|HttpRequest.newBuilder|.uri(|.getForObject|.getForEntity|.exchange(|new HttpGet|new HttpPost|.url(|Jsoup.connect over @RequestParam|@PathVariable|request.get* -- check the host against a fixed allowlist before it reaches the call

cwe.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

rules.title: Zip slip: archive entry name used unchecked
rules.refuses: a `new File`/`Paths.get`/`.resolve` built from a `ZipEntry`/`JarEntry`/`TarArchiveEntry` `.getName()`, in a method that never checks the resolved path stays inside the destination directory
rules.silent_on: the same construction beside `.normalize()` and a `.startsWith()` check on the result; a `.toRealPath()` check; `.getName()` in a file that never opens an archive
rules.constraint: never(extract): new File(dir, entry.getName())|Paths.get(dir).resolve(entry.getName()) with no .normalize()+.startsWith(dir) or .toRealPath() check in the method -- the entry name can be '../../etc/passwd'

cwe.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

rules.title: LDAP filter built from request data
rules.refuses: a `DirContext`/`InitialDirContext`/`LdapTemplate` `.search()` a method body shows request data reaching unescaped, in a file that imports the LDAP APIs
rules.silent_on: the same search over a value passed through `LdapEncoder`; Spring LDAP's query builder with `.is()`; a constant filter; `.search()` in a file with no LDAP import
rules.constraint: never(search): DirContext|InitialDirContext|LdapTemplate .search( over @RequestParam|@PathVariable|request.get* -- escape with LdapEncoder.filterEncode, or build the query with Spring LDAP's query()/.is()

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

rules.title: XPath expression built from request data
rules.refuses: an `XPath.compile()`/`.evaluate()` a method body shows request data reaching unbound, in a file that imports `javax.xml.xpath`
rules.silent_on: the same call over a value bound through `XPathVariableResolver`; a constant expression; `.compile()`/`.evaluate()` in a file with no `javax.xml.xpath` import
rules.constraint: never(query): XPath .compile(|.evaluate( over @RequestParam|@PathVariable|request.get* -- bind the value through XPathVariableResolver rather than concatenating it into the expression

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')
XML Injection (aka Blind XPath Injection)

rules.title: Weak cipher algorithm or ECB mode
rules.refuses: DES, DESede, RC2, RC4/ARCFOUR, Blowfish; any `/ECB/` mode; bare `"AES"`
rules.silent_on: AES/GCM/NoPadding; ChaCha20-Poly1305; AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding; RSA/ECB/OAEP* and RSA/ECB/PKCS1Padding
rules.constraint: never(call): Cipher.getInstance(DES|DESede|RC2|RC4|ARCFOUR|Blowfish|.../ECB/...|bare "AES") -- use AES/GCM/NoPadding or ChaCha20-Poly1305 with a fresh SecureRandom nonce

cwe.name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

rules.title: Fast digest used to hash a password
rules.refuses: MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256 (or DigestUtils' hex forms) whose digested/updated argument is itself named password/passwd/pwd (whole name or last segment)
rules.silent_on: the same digests fed a value not named as a password (a checksum, an ETag, file bytes), even in a method that separately logs something about a password; BCrypt/Argon2/PBKDF2/SCrypt
rules.constraint: never(hash): MessageDigest MD5|SHA-1|SHA-256 or DigestUtils.md5Hex|sha1Hex|sha256Hex over an argument that IS a password name -- use BCrypt|Argon2|PBKDF2|SCrypt, which are slow and salted

cwe.name: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

rules.title: Predictable random used for a secret value
rules.refuses: a plain Random/Math.random/ThreadLocalRandom/RandomStringUtils value named as a token/secret/otp/nonce/salt/session id/api key/reset code
rules.silent_on: the same constructs used to shuffle, sample or drive a game; any use of SecureRandom
rules.constraint: never(generate): new Random()|Math.random()|ThreadLocalRandom.current()|RandomStringUtils.random* assigned to a token|secret|password|otp|nonce|salt|session id|api key|reset code -- use SecureRandom

cwe.name: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)

rules.title: TLS trust manager or hostname verifier that accepts everything
rules.refuses: a checkServerTrusted/checkClientTrusted body that never throws; a verify() that always returns true; NoopHostnameVerifier, ALLOW_ALL_HOSTNAME_VERIFIER, TrustAllStrategy, TrustSelfSignedStrategy, InsecureTrustManagerFactory.INSTANCE
rules.silent_on: a trust manager or verifier that delegates to a real check and can reject
rules.constraint: never(implement): checkServerTrusted|checkClientTrusted with an empty or return-only body, or a HostnameVerifier.verify that always returns true, or NoopHostnameVerifier|ALLOW_ALL_HOSTNAME_VERIFIER|TrustAllStrategy|TrustSelfSignedStrategy|InsecureTrustManagerFactory.INSTANCE -- delegate to the platform default or a pinned trust store

cwe.name: Improper Certificate Validation

rules.title: Legacy SSL/TLS protocol version
rules.refuses: SSLContext.getInstance/setEnabledProtocols/enabled-protocols naming SSL, SSLv2, SSLv3, TLSv1, or TLSv1.1
rules.silent_on: "TLS", "TLSv1.2", "TLSv1.3"
rules.constraint: never(enable): SSLContext.getInstance|setEnabledProtocols|enabled-protocols with "SSL"|"SSLv2"|"SSLv3"|"TLSv1"|"TLSv1.1" -- use "TLS" or name "TLSv1.2"/"TLSv1.3"

cwe.name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

rules.title: Static IV, nonce, or salt
rules.refuses: an IvParameterSpec/GCMParameterSpec/PBEKeySpec built from a literal string or byte array, or from a fixed-size array the method never fills with SecureRandom.nextBytes
rules.silent_on: the same array filled by SecureRandom.nextBytes(...) earlier in the method
rules.constraint: never(construct): IvParameterSpec|GCMParameterSpec|PBEKeySpec from a literal "...".getBytes()/byte[]{...}, or a `new byte[N]` never filled by SecureRandom.nextBytes in the same method -- fill it with SecureRandom.nextBytes() first

cwe.name: Generation of Predictable IV with CBC Mode
Reusing a Nonce, Key Pair in Encryption
Use of a One-Way Hash with a Predictable Salt

rules.title: Key or iteration count below today's size floor
rules.refuses: RSA/DSA/DH below 2048 bits, EC below 224 bits, AES below 128 bits, PBEKeySpec below 10000 iterations
rules.silent_on: a literal size or iteration count at or above these floors; a size read from configuration rather than a literal
rules.constraint: never(initialize): KeyPairGenerator RSA|DSA|DH below 2048, EC below 224, KeyGenerator AES below 128, or PBEKeySpec below 10000 iterations -- raise it to the floor this pack documents

cwe.name: Inadequate Encryption Strength

rules.title: Credential literal in source
rules.refuses: a non-empty literal password/secret passed to DriverManager.getConnection, PasswordAuthentication, dataSource.setPassword, SecretKeySpec, or Algorithm.HMAC256/384/512
rules.silent_on: the same calls given a variable, an env/config/vault read, or an empty string literal; anything under src/test/
rules.constraint: never(write): DriverManager.getConnection|PasswordAuthentication|setPassword|SecretKeySpec|Algorithm.HMAC* with a non-empty string literal as the secret -- read it from environment, configuration, or a vault

cwe.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
Use of Hard-coded Password

rules.title: Wildcard CORS origin with credentials
rules.refuses: a wildcard origin **with** credentials enabled
rules.silent_on: a wildcard alone; a named origin; `setAllowedOriginPatterns`
rules.constraint: never(pair): CORS origin "*" with allowCredentials(true) -- the spec refuses it; name the origins, or use setAllowedOriginPatterns

cwe.name: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

rules.title: Every actuator endpoint exposed
rules.refuses: `exposure.include=*` in properties or YAML
rules.silent_on: named endpoints; a wildcard `include:` outside actuator config
rules.constraint: never(expose): management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=* -- it publishes heapdump and env; name the endpoints served

cwe.name: Exposure of Sensitive System Information to an Unauthorized Control Sphere

rules.title: CSRF protection disabled
rules.refuses: csrf().disable(), the method-reference and lambda forms, and the Kotlin DSL block
rules.silent_on: ignoringRequestMatchers(...) scoped to specific paths; files with no HttpSecurity
rules.constraint: never(disable): .csrf().disable()|csrf(...::disable)|csrf { disable() } -- fine only for a stateless token API; otherwise scope it with ignoringRequestMatchers

cwe.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)

rules.title: permitAll() on every request
rules.refuses: anyRequest()/"/**" matchers passed to permitAll() or web.ignoring(), and the Kotlin DSL form
rules.silent_on: a specific public path such as "/public/**" or "/actuator/health"
rules.constraint: never(catchall): anyRequest().permitAll()|requestMatchers("/**").permitAll()|web.ignoring().requestMatchers("/**") -- match specific public paths instead

cwe.name: Missing Authorization

rules.title: Weak or absent password encoder
rules.refuses: the no-op and legacy digest encoders, a {noop} literal, and withDefaultPasswordEncoder() outside test sources
rules.silent_on: BCryptPasswordEncoder, Argon2PasswordEncoder, Pbkdf2PasswordEncoder, SCryptPasswordEncoder, DelegatingPasswordEncoder, a {bcrypt} literal, and test sources
rules.constraint: never(hash): NoOpPasswordEncoder|Md5/Sha/Standard/LdapSha/MessageDigestPasswordEncoder|"{noop}" password|User.withDefaultPasswordEncoder() -- use BCrypt, Argon2 or Pbkdf2

cwe.name: Plaintext Storage of a Password
Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

rules.title: SpEL expression built from request data
rules.refuses: parseExpression() where a method body shows request data reaching it
rules.silent_on: a constant expression string; files that never mention SpEL's parser types
rules.constraint: never(parse): SpelExpressionParser().parseExpression(<request data>) -- SpEL executes; pick from a fixed set of named expressions instead

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an Expression Language Statement ('Expression Language Injection')

rules.title: Redirect target built from request data
rules.refuses: a redirect: prefix, RedirectView, a Location header, or sendRedirect built from request data
rules.silent_on: a target checked against an allowlist or UriComponentsBuilder host, or a same-site startsWith check
rules.constraint: never(redirect): "redirect:" + <request data>|new RedirectView(<request data>)|response.sendRedirect(<request data>) -- check against an allowlist, or require a same-site path

cwe.name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

rules.title: View name built from request data
rules.refuses: return "prefix/" + <request data>; in a @Controller method that is not @ResponseBody
rules.silent_on: a constant view name; @RestController classes; a method annotated @ResponseBody; a "redirect:"/"forward:" prefix (the open-redirect rule owns those)
rules.constraint: never(return): a view name concatenated with request data in a @Controller method -- map the value to a view name through a fixed lookup instead

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

rules.title: Plaintext secret in application config
rules.refuses: a secret-shaped key set to a non-empty literal in main application/bootstrap config
rules.silent_on: an empty value; a boolean or number; a ${...} placeholder; a {cipher}/ENC()/vault:/sm:// reference; test resources
rules.constraint: never(set): a *.password|*secret|*.token|*.api-key|*.private-key|*.credentials key to a literal in application*/bootstrap* config -- reference ${ENV_VAR} or a {cipher} value instead

cwe.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
Plaintext Storage of a Password

rules.title: H2 console reachable from other hosts
rules.refuses: spring.h2.console.settings.web-allow-others=true
rules.silent_on: the key set to false, or absent (the framework default)
rules.constraint: never(set): spring.h2.console.settings.web-allow-others=true -- the H2 console runs arbitrary SQL with no auth of its own; leave it false

cwe.name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

rules.title: Stack trace or exception exposed in error responses
rules.refuses: include-stacktrace=always/on_param, and include-exception=true
rules.silent_on: include-stacktrace=never, or the key absent (the framework default)
rules.constraint: never(set): server.error.include-stacktrace=always|on_param, or server.error.include-exception=true -- log the detail server-side instead

cwe.name: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

rules.title: Sensitive actuator endpoint or value exposed
rules.refuses: show-values=ALWAYS on env/configprops, a sensitive endpoint named in exposure.include, and shutdown enabled or access=unrestricted
rules.silent_on: the default masked show-values, health/info/metrics in exposure.include, and shutdown left disabled (the wildcard `*` itself is the other actuator rule's own case)
rules.constraint: never(set): management.endpoint.{env,configprops}.show-values=ALWAYS, heapdump/env/threaddump/jolokia/shutdown/logfile named in exposure.include, or shutdown enabled/unrestricted -- keep values masked and these endpoints off the web

cwe.name: Exposure of Sensitive System Information to an Unauthorized Control Sphere

rules.title: Spring Security debug mode enabled
rules.refuses: @EnableWebSecurity(debug = true) and web.debug(true)
rules.silent_on: @EnableWebSecurity() with no debug flag, and .debug(false)
rules.constraint: never(set): @EnableWebSecurity(debug = true), or web.debug(true) -- logs the full filter chain and request details; not for production

cwe.name: Active Debug Code
Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Debugging Code

rules.title: Session-fixation protection disabled
rules.refuses: sessionFixation().none(), its lambda form, and the Kotlin DSL block
rules.silent_on: sessionFixation().migrateSession()/changeSessionId(), and files with no HttpSecurity
rules.constraint: never(disable): sessionFixation().none()|sessionFixation { none() } -- keep migrateSession() or changeSessionId() so login always issues a fresh session id

cwe.name: Session Fixation

rules.title: Security response headers disabled
rules.refuses: headers()/frameOptions()/contentTypeOptions()/HSTS disable(), literal or lambda
rules.silent_on: frameOptions().sameOrigin(), and files with no HttpSecurity
rules.constraint: never(disable): headers().disable()|frameOptions().disable()|contentTypeOptions().disable()|httpStrictTransportSecurity().disable() -- keep the header on; drop only what must come off

cwe.name: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

rules.title: Session cookie missing Secure or HttpOnly
rules.refuses: cookie.secure/http-only=false in config, and .secure(false)/.httpOnly(false) in a ResponseCookie chain
rules.silent_on: the cookie flags left at their true default, and cookies built without ResponseCookie
rules.constraint: never(set): server.servlet.session.cookie.{secure,http-only}=false, or ResponseCookie...secure(false)/httpOnly(false) -- keep both true

cwe.name: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag

rules.title: Remote DevTools enabled
rules.refuses: spring.devtools.remote.secret set to a non-empty value in main application config
rules.silent_on: the key absent, an empty value, and test resources
rules.constraint: never(set): spring.devtools.remote.secret=<value> in application/bootstrap config -- remote DevTools accepts a class-reload payload once the secret is known; keep it local-only

cwe.name: Active Debug Code

rules.title: Open redirect from request data
rules.refuses: a redirect target a method body shows request data reaching, in a Servlet/JAX-RS/Vert.x/Micronaut file
rules.silent_on: a constant redirect target; a target checked against an allowlist first; Spring code
rules.constraint: never(redirect): sendRedirect|Response.seeOther|.putHeader("Location"|HttpResponse.redirect built from @QueryParam|@PathParam|request.get* -- check against a fixed allowlist first

cwe.name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

rules.title: Server-side forward to a request-chosen path
rules.refuses: a getRequestDispatcher path a method body shows request data reaching
rules.silent_on: a constant dispatcher path; a path chosen from a fixed lookup table; Spring code
rules.constraint: never(forward): getRequestDispatcher(...) built from @QueryParam|@PathParam|request.get* -- map the request to a fixed path with a lookup table, never the raw value

cwe.name: Unintended Proxy or Intermediary ('Confused Deputy')

rules.title: Wildcard CORS origin with credentials
rules.refuses: a wildcard CORS origin **with** credentials enabled, in a non-Spring file
rules.silent_on: a wildcard alone; a named origin; credentials without a wildcard; Spring code
rules.constraint: never(pair): CORS origin "*" (raw header, Vert.x CorsHandler, quarkus.http.cors.origins, micronaut allowed-origins) with credentials enabled -- name the origins instead

cwe.name: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

rules.title: Directory listing enabled
rules.refuses: directory listing turned on, in servlet, Jetty, Undertow or Vert.x/Quarkus config
rules.silent_on: listing left off or explicitly false; Spring code
rules.constraint: never(enable): web.xml listings=true|Jetty dirAllowed=true|Undertow directory-listing=true|StaticHandler.setDirectoryListing(true) -- turn listing off

cwe.name: Exposure of Information Through Directory Listing

rules.title: HTTP method constraint scoped to listed verbs
rules.refuses: a web-resource-collection naming <http-method> with no <http-method-omission>
rules.silent_on: <http-method-omission>; a collection with no method list at all (covers every verb)
rules.constraint: never(scope): <web-resource-collection> with <http-method> and no <http-method-omission> -- unlisted verbs bypass the constraint; use <http-method-omission> or list none

cwe.name: Missing Authorization

rules.title: Struts OGNL exposure
rules.refuses: struts.xml/struts.properties turning on dev mode, static access or DMI; a value-stack lookup a method body shows request data reaching
rules.silent_on: those keys left false or absent; a fixed OGNL expression; non-Struts XML/properties
rules.constraint: never(enable): struts.devMode|struts.ognl.allowStaticMethodAccess|struts.enable.DynamicMethodInvocation = true; never(evaluate): ValueStack.findValue(...) built from request data

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an Expression Language Statement ('Expression Language Injection')

rules.title: Cookie flag turned off explicitly
rules.refuses: an explicit `setHttpOnly(false)`/`setSecure(false)`; web.xml cookie-config set false
rules.silent_on: flags left true, or left unset; a cookie-config that sets neither to false; Spring code
rules.constraint: never(disable): cookie.setHttpOnly(false)|cookie.setSecure(false)|web.xml <cookie-config> http-only|secure = false -- set both true unless the cookie is not sensitive

cwe.name: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag

rules.title: Micronaut security disabled
rules.refuses: `micronaut.security.enabled=false` in the main application config
rules.silent_on: security left enabled or unset; the same key in a file whose path names it as test
rules.constraint: never(disable): micronaut.security.enabled=false in application config -- leave security enabled, secure individual endpoints with @Secured

cwe.name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

rules.title: MyBatis string interpolation in SQL
rules.refuses: `${}` in a mapper or a MyBatis-annotated source
rules.silent_on: `#{}`, and `${}` anywhere that is not MyBatis
rules.constraint: never(interpolate): mybatis ${...} in mapper|@Select|@Insert|@Update|@Delete -- ${} is pasted into the SQL text before preparing; bind with #{...}

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

rules.title: SQL/JPQL string built by concatenation
rules.refuses: a query string built by `+`, `String.format`/`.formatted`, or `StringBuilder`/`StringBuffer.append` of a non-constant value, reaching a JDBC statement, JdbcTemplate, JPA `EntityManager`, Hibernate session, jOOQ `DSL`, or `@Query` sink
rules.silent_on: bind parameters (`?`, `:name`, `#{}`); concatenation of literals or ALL_CAPS constants only; Criteria API, QueryDSL, and jOOQ DSL builders built from values rather than joined text; and a file that never mentions JDBC/JPA/Hibernate/jOOQ
rules.constraint: never(join): a SQL/JPQL/HQL string built with +|String.format|.formatted|StringBuilder.append of a non-constant, reaching executeQuery|execute|prepareStatement|JdbcTemplate.query*|createQuery|createNativeQuery|DSL.sql|@Query -- bind with ?|:name|#{} instead

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
SQL Injection: Hibernate

rules.title: Unsafe JDBC URL parameter
rules.refuses: a jdbc: URL setting autoDeserialize, allowLoadLocalInfile or allowUrlInLocalInfile anywhere, or the TLS-weakening flags (useSSL=false, sslMode=DISABLED, trustServerCertificate=true, encrypt=false, allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true, verifyServerCertificate=false) against a non-local host
rules.silent_on: the TLS-weakening flags against localhost/127.0.0.1/an in-memory H2 database, and any of these flags under src/test/
rules.constraint: never(set): a jdbc: URL with autoDeserialize=true|allowLoadLocalInfile=true|allowUrlInLocalInfile=true|allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true|useSSL=false|sslMode=DISABLED|sslmode=disable|trustServerCertificate=true|encrypt=false|verifyServerCertificate=false -- remove the flag or set its safe value

cwe.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
Improper Certificate Validation

rules.title: Destructive schema-generation in main config
rules.refuses: `ddl-auto`/`hbm2ddl.auto`/`schema-generation.database.action` set to `create`, `create-drop`, `drop` or `update` in application.properties/yml, an application-prod* profile, persistence.xml or hibernate.cfg.xml
rules.silent_on: `validate` and `none`; the same key in an application-dev/-local/-test profile or under src/test/; and any file that is not a Spring/Hibernate/JPA config file
rules.constraint: never(set): spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto|hibernate.hbm2ddl.auto|javax|jakarta.persistence.schema-generation.database.action to create|create-drop|drop|update in main config -- use validate|none and a migration tool

cwe.name: Initialization of a Resource with an Insecure Default

rules.title: MongoDB query built from a joined or request-shaped string
rules.refuses: a `$where` clause joining in a non-constant value with `+`; `new BasicQuery(`, `Document.parse(`, `BasicDBObject.parse(` or `JSON.parse(` built by joining in a non-constant, or a method body shows reaching request data
rules.silent_on: a fixed JSON/document literal; concatenation of literals or ALL_CAPS constants only; and a file that never imports a MongoDB driver
rules.constraint: never(join): mongo $where, new BasicQuery(...)|Document.parse(...)|BasicDBObject.parse(...)|JSON.parse(...) built with + of a non-constant or reaching request data -- use the typed query builder or bind the value

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic
Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

rules.title: Unescaped template output
rules.refuses: `th:utext`, `[(${...})]`, `<%=`, `escapeXml="false"`, `escape="false"` (JSF), `?no_esc`, `<#noescape>`, `| raw` (Pebble), `{{{` / `{{&` (Mustache/Handlebars)
rules.silent_on: the escaping sibling of each, and other `<% %>` forms
rules.constraint: never(write): th:utext|[(${|<%=|escapeXml="false"|escape="false"|?no_esc|<#noescape>|raw|{{{|{{& -- these put a value into the page as markup; use the escaping sibling

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

rules.title: Template compiled from request data
rules.refuses: a method body showing request data reaching FreeMarker `new Template(`/`StringTemplateLoader.putTemplate(`, Velocity `evaluate(`/`RuntimeSingleton.parse(`, Thymeleaf `templateEngine.process(` when the file also configures a `StringTemplateResolver`, Pebble `engine.getLiteralTemplate(`, Mustache `compiler().compile(new StringReader(`, `Handlebars.compileInline(`, or Jinjava `render(`
rules.silent_on: a fixed template string; loading a template by name (`getTemplate(`) rather than compiling text; Thymeleaf `process(` with no `StringTemplateResolver` in the file; and a file that never configures one of these engines
rules.constraint: never(compile): FreeMarker new Template(...)|Velocity.evaluate(...)|templateEngine.process(...) with a StringTemplateResolver|Pebble engine.getLiteralTemplate(...)|Mustache compiler().compile(new StringReader(...))|Handlebars.compileInline(...)|Jinjava.render(...) reaching request data -- load a fixed template by name; pass only data in

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

rules.title: Template engine auto-escaping disabled
rules.refuses: Pebble `.autoEscaping(false)`, Handlebars `EscapingStrategy.NOOP`, FreeMarker `setOutputFormat(PlainTextOutputFormat.INSTANCE)`/`setAutoEscapingPolicy(Configuration.DISABLE_AUTO_ESCAPING_POLICY)`, or `.ftlh` `output_format="plainText"`/`auto_esc=false`
rules.silent_on: any of these method names in a file that never imports that template engine, and a `.ftlh` file that never sets those directives
rules.constraint: never(disable): Pebble .autoEscaping(false)|Handlebars EscapingStrategy.NOOP|FreeMarker setOutputFormat(PlainTextOutputFormat.INSTANCE)|setAutoEscapingPolicy(DISABLE_AUTO_ESCAPING_POLICY)|.ftlh output_format="plainText"|auto_esc=false -- leave auto-escaping on; mark the rare safe value at its call site

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output

rules.title: FreeMarker unrestricted ?new/?api builtin
rules.refuses: `?new(` and `?api` in a `.ftl`/`.ftlh`/`.ftlx` template, and `setNewBuiltinClassResolver(TemplateClassResolver.UNRESTRICTED_RESOLVER)` or `setAPIBuiltinEnabled(true)` in Java/Kotlin
rules.silent_on: `ALLOWS_NOTHING_RESOLVER` and `SAFER_RESOLVER`
rules.constraint: never(reach): freemarker ?new(...)|?api in a template, or setNewBuiltinClassResolver(TemplateClassResolver.UNRESTRICTED_RESOLVER)|setAPIBuiltinEnabled(true) in Java -- restrict the class resolver to SAFER_RESOLVER or ALLOWS_NOTHING_RESOLVER

cwe.name: Use of Externally-Controlled Input to Select Classes or Code ('Unsafe Reflection')

rules.title: Template include path taken from the request
rules.refuses: `<jsp:include page="<%= request.getParameter...`, `<c:import url="${param....`, `<jsp:include page="${param....`, Thymeleaf `th:replace="${param....`/`th:insert="${param....`/`~{${param....` fragment expressions
rules.silent_on: a constant include path, and `param`/request use that is not the include path itself
rules.constraint: never(include): <jsp:include page="<%= request.getParameter|<c:import url="${param.|<jsp:include page="${param.|th:replace="${param.|th:insert="${param.|~{${param. -- include a fixed path, or key an allowlist by the caller's choice

cwe.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
External Control of File Name or Path

rules.title: Log4j 2 message-lookup exposure
rules.refuses: `log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=false`; `%m{lookups}`/`%msg{lookups}` in a pattern; a literal `${jndi:`
rules.silent_on: an ordinary pattern layout with no lookups token; formatMsgNoLookups=true
rules.constraint: never(configure): log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=false, a pattern using %m{lookups}/%msg{lookups}, or a literal "${jndi:" -- Log4j 2.15+ disables message lookups by default; do not turn them back on

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an Expression Language Statement ('Expression Language Injection')
Deserialization of Untrusted Data

rules.title: Secret value passed to a logger
rules.refuses: a logger call whose concatenated or {}-argument identifier IS a secret name (its whole name, or its last camelCase/snake_case segment) and is not masked
rules.silent_on: the same words only as part of a longer identifier (tokenType, tokenCount, passwordPolicy, tokenizer, tokens); the same name only inside the message's string literal; a value passed through mask(...)/redact(...) or already shown as ****
rules.constraint: never(log): a value named password|passwd|secret|token|apiKey|accessToken|refreshToken|privateKey|creditCard|cardNumber|cvv|ssn passed or concatenated into a logger call -- log an identifier, or mask the value first

cwe.name: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

rules.title: Stack trace or exception detail sent to the caller
rules.refuses: printStackTrace(response.getWriter()); response.getWriter().write/print of e.getMessage()/e.getStackTrace()/ExceptionUtils.getStackTrace(e); a .body(...) built from either
rules.silent_on: logging the exception server-side; a response body built from a fixed error message or an error code
rules.constraint: never(write): e.printStackTrace(response.getWriter()), getWriter().write/print of getMessage()/getStackTrace()/ExceptionUtils.getStackTrace(), or a response body built from either -- log server-side and return a generic error with a correlation id

cwe.name: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

rules.title: Request data concatenated into a log line
rules.refuses: a method body showing request data reaching a logger call through string concatenation
rules.silent_on: the same value passed as a {} placeholder argument rather than concatenated; a constant message
rules.constraint: never(concatenate): request data with '+' into a log.info/warn/error/debug/trace call -- pass it as a {} placeholder argument, or strip control characters first

cwe.name: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs

rules.title: Build repository fetched over plain HTTP
rules.refuses: an http:// repository, mirror or wrapper URL; `allowInsecureProtocol = true`
rules.silent_on: https:// URLs; http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1
rules.constraint: never(fetch): a repository/mirror/pluginRepository/distributionManagement url, or the wrapper distributionUrl, over http:// -- use https://, loopback URLs excepted

cwe.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
Download of Code Without Integrity Check

rules.title: Dependency checksum verification disabled
rules.refuses: Maven `checksumPolicy` set to `ignore`; Gradle dependency verification set to `off`
rules.silent_on: `checksumPolicy` left at `fail` or set to `warn`; verification left at `strict`/`lenient`
rules.constraint: never(disable): maven <checksumPolicy>ignore</checksumPolicy>; gradle org.gradle.dependency.verification=off -- keep checksums enforced

cwe.name: Missing Support for Integrity Check
Download of Code Without Integrity Check

rules.title: Dependency below the version that fixed a known-exploited CVE
rules.refuses: a declared, resolvable version inside one of these ranges
rules.silent_on: a version at or above the fix; a BOM-managed dependency with no explicit version; a version behind an unresolvable property
rules.constraint: never(declare): log4j-core 2.0-beta9-<2.17.1, spring-beans 5.3.0-<5.3.18|5.2.0-<5.2.20, spring-webmvc 5.3.0-<5.3.18|5.2.0-<5.2.20, spring-webflux 5.3.0-<5.3.18|5.2.0-<5.2.20, spring-cloud-function-context <3.1.7|3.2.0-<3.2.3, commons-text 1.5-<1.10, xstream <1.4.18, snakeyaml <2.0, fastjson <1.2.83, struts2-core <2.5.33|6.0.0-<6.3.0.2, h2 <2.1.210, shiro-core <1.9.1 -- raise to the first version that fixed the named CVE

cwe.name: Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component

rules.title: Dependency pinned to a dynamic version
rules.refuses: a Gradle `+`/`latest.release`/`latest.integration` version; Maven `LATEST`/`RELEASE`/an open range
rules.silent_on: a pinned exact version; a closed Maven range with both bounds named
rules.constraint: never(pin): a dependency version of +, latest.release, latest.integration, Maven LATEST/RELEASE, or an open range [1.0,) -- name one exact released version

cwe.name: Reliance on Insufficiently Trustworthy Component

rules.title: WebView JS bridge or file-URL access with JavaScript enabled
rules.refuses: `addJavascriptInterface(` or a file-URL-access setter turned on, in a file where JS is enabled
rules.silent_on: either call in a file that never enables JavaScript; a WebView with JS left off
rules.constraint: never(bind): addJavascriptInterface, or setAllowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs|setAllowFileAccessFromFileURLs|setAllowFileAccess(true), where the same file's WebView also has setJavaScriptEnabled(true) -- drop the bridge, or scope file access off

cwe.name: Exposed Dangerous Method or Function

rules.title: WebView TLS error proceeded through
rules.refuses: `.proceed()` on the handler inside an `onReceivedSslError` override
rules.silent_on: `.cancel()` inside the same override; a file that never overrides it
rules.constraint: never(proceed): handler.proceed() inside WebViewClient.onReceivedSslError -- call handler.cancel(), or remove the override entirely

cwe.name: Improper Certificate Validation

rules.title: World-readable or world-writable file
rules.refuses: `MODE_WORLD_READABLE`/`MODE_WORLD_WRITEABLE`; `setReadable`/`setWritable(true, false)`
rules.silent_on: `MODE_PRIVATE`; `setReadable(true, true)`/`setReadable(true)` (owner-only)
rules.constraint: never(open): Context.MODE_WORLD_READABLE|MODE_WORLD_WRITEABLE; never(chmod): file.setReadable(true, false)|setWritable(true, false) -- use MODE_PRIVATE

cwe.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
Incorrect Default Permissions

rules.title: AndroidManifest.xml marked debuggable
rules.refuses: `android:debuggable="true"` outside a debug source set
rules.silent_on: `android:debuggable="false"`; the attribute absent; a manifest under `src/debug/`
rules.constraint: never(set): android:debuggable="true" in AndroidManifest.xml -- let the build type control it, never the manifest

cwe.name: Active Debug Code
Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Debugging Code

rules.title: allowBackup enabled with no backup rules
rules.refuses: `allowBackup="true"` in a manifest naming no fullBackupContent/dataExtractionRules
rules.silent_on: `allowBackup="false"`; `allowBackup="true"` alongside either backup-rules attribute
rules.constraint: never(set): android:allowBackup="true" in AndroidManifest.xml with no fullBackupContent/dataExtractionRules -- name what may be backed up, or turn backup off

cwe.name: Exposure of Backup File to an Unauthorized Control Sphere
Storage of Sensitive Data in a Mechanism without Access Control

rules.title: Cleartext traffic permitted app-wide
rules.refuses: `usesCleartextTraffic="true"` in the manifest; `cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"` on `<base-config>`
rules.silent_on: the manifest attribute set to `"false"` or absent; `cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"` inside a `<domain-config>`
rules.constraint: never(set): android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" in AndroidManifest.xml, or cleartextTrafficPermitted="true" on <base-config> -- scope it to a named <domain-config>

cwe.name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information

rules.title: User-installed CAs trusted app-wide
rules.refuses: `<certificates src="user" />` inside `<base-config>`
rules.silent_on: the same element inside a `<domain-config>`; `src="system"`
rules.constraint: never(trust): <certificates src="user" /> inside <base-config> in a network security config -- scope the user trust anchor to a named <domain-config> instead

cwe.name: Improper Certificate Validation

rules.title: Exported component with no permission
rules.refuses: an exported activity/service/receiver/provider with no `android:permission`
rules.silent_on: `android:permission` present; `exported="false"` or the attribute omitted; the launcher activity
rules.constraint: never(export): activity|service|receiver|provider with android:exported="true" and no android:permission -- name a permission, or set exported="false"; the launcher activity's own MAIN/LAUNCHER intent-filter is the one exception

cwe.name: Improper Export of Android Application Components
Missing Authorization

bounds.review_before_apply: Every answer is a row you can tick and edit before anything is written. The java-security skill is the only thing that writes, and only after you have reviewed every row.
bounds.relaunch_to_edit: There is no separate edit mode. An existing selection prefills every rule's current verdict, so changing an answer means reopening this page, not finding a second flow.
bounds.sandbox: This page is a file: inline and offline, nothing it loads reaches outside itself, and nothing it does can reach the network.
bounds.accessibility: Every control is reachable by keyboard and carries a label a screen reader can read; no choice depends on color alone.
bounds.theme_choice: The page renders correctly in both light and dark themes on its own, and offers an explicit toggle besides.
bounds.verdicts_are_chosen_never_derived: A verdict is what you choose for a rule, never something inferred from a question about your stack. There is no field here a stack answer could land in.
bounds.plugin_tier_is_not_commit_or_ci: Installing this policy as an agent plugin reaches that agent's own tool calls and turn end. It does not reach a commit or a CI run -- those need the policy installed in the repository itself with chock.
bounds.nothing_written_from_the_page: This page writes nothing. It produces a result the java-security skill reads, shows you row by row, refuses to overwrite an existing selection without your say-so, and only then writes .chock/security.json.
